NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Moki Rescue uses your location only while you create or handle a rescue request. Your location is not tracked when no request is active.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Rescue providers can let Moki Rescue update their location in the background only while handling an active request. Customers do not need this permission.
NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Moki Rescue updates a rescue provider's background location only during an active request.
